name: Pub
concept: The pub and cafe of Saint-Philippe, 1989: the two-storey vanilla PubVillage_E_2L01 (Saint-Philippe b03, the V8 variant with the wall sign, 17.9 x 17 m) fitted whole. The taproom with its bar counter, taps and kegs is where the town drinks in the evening; the front room is the daytime cafe with small tables, a radio and a chess board; the keg store, kitchen and toilets stay as the base game has them. Upstairs is the landlord's flat and two rooms to let. Drinks are the existing survival consumables (eat and drink by doing, character-survival) sold over the counter through a `store` block; no new system. This card is the shell: the vanilla set pruned from 287 props to the ones the rooms read from, before pass 1 dresses it. Base-game props only.

host.note: Building space is prefab space (x across, y up from the taproom floor, z along). The street face with the pub sign is the -z wall; proof.json stands the camera there. Saint-Philippe placement is town fit later; until then the building stands in its pack grid cell, claim pub (c17r0).

rooms.use: the bar counter (two BarTable_01 with taps, the till) along z -4.6, the bottle shelves behind it, the drinking tables at the -z street wall
the daytime cafe: small tables, the clock, the radio and chess board in pass 1
kegs, freezer, rack and crates: the back of house
stove, old sink, small fridge and cupboard
the landlord's flat and two rooms to let (vanilla beds, cupboards, chairs)

interactables.system: store (a `store` block in a later pass)
interactables.note: the bar till sells the survival drink and food items
drink by drinking: the bottles sold are the existing consumable items
